name: Energía de Bordes de Cuadro
algorithm: Frame Edge Energy — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes frame-level edge energy distribution for video deepfake detection:

1. **Borde Energy Cálculo**: Per frame, edge energy is computed using Sobel/Canny operators: E_edge = Σ(|∇I|²) over the frame. The spatial distribution of edge energy is mapped, revealing where visual detail and boundaries are concentrated.

2. **Rostro - Background Borde Energy Ratio**: In authentic video, the edge energy density in face regions vs. background follows a consistent ratio determined by the imaging pipeline. Deepfake composites may show different edge energy characteristics between the generated face (from one rendering pipeline) and the original background.

3. **Temporal Borde Energy Análisis**: Total frame edge energy is tracked over time. Natural video shows smooth edge energy variation corresponding to motion and scene changes. Deepfake generation may produce frame-to-frame edge energy fluctuations — particularly in face regions where the generator's ability to reproduce edge detail varies with head pose and expression.

4. **Borde Frecuencia Distribución**: The distribution of edge magnitudes per frame is analyzed. Natural edge magnitude distributions follow power-law statistics. AI-generated content may produce different edge magnitude distributions — often lacking the heavy tail of strong edges or showing excess medium-strength edges from the generator's activation functions.

5. **Multi - Directional Borde Energy**: Edge energy is decomposed by direction (horizontal, vertical, diagonal). Natural scenes show direction-dependent edge energy distributions (buildings have strong horizontal/vertical edges). AI-generated content may show unnatural directional edge energy, particularly checkerboard-like patterns from transposed convolution artifacts in the generator.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante frame edge energy analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
